applies_to_institution: Technische Universitaet Berlin|Charite - Universitaetsmedizin Berlin|Freie Universitaet Berlin|Humboldt-Universitaet zu Berlin

Max 3 courses per applicant.
application_window: Set by each individual EPOS course, not by the DAAD; applications go directly to the course. Current list is 'List of all Postgraduate courses with application deadlines 2027/2028' (Stand 06/2026).
deadline: Course-specific - see the DAAD EPOS deadlines list for 2027/2028; TU Berlin Urban Management and Charite International Health both say 'see website of the course'

red_flags: THE TWO-YEAR PROFESSIONAL-EXPERIENCE BAR IS ABSOLUTE - a 2027 graduate straight out of the engineering diploma is NOT eligible. Only 2 Berlin courses exist and neither is software/music. German-track courses require B1 German at application and DSH-2/TestDaF-4 before the course starts.

For English-taught courses only English per course rules. Both Berlin courses are English-taught. Realistic only if the client works 2+ years before applying.

scholarship_name: DAAD Study Scholarships - Master Studies for All Academic Disciplines

applies_to_city: any (Germany, incl. all Berlin state universities)

nationality_restrictions: Restricted to a closed country list which is essentially Europe, the CIS, and industrialised countries
tunisia_eligible_evidence: Country selector lists Afghanistan...Syria, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Ukraine, UK, USA, Uzbekistan, Yemen - Tunisia is absent. "If your status and/or country is not included in the list, you cannot apply for this scholarship programme."

amount_notes: 992 EUR/month, travel allowance on application, one-off study allowance, health/accident/personal-liability insurance contributions, possible rent subsidy and family allowance, Green Mobility top-up, funded online language course plus a 2/4/6-month German course before the study visit.
duration_covered: Degree studies: 2 to 4 semesters (10-24 months). Advanced studies without a degree: 12 months, extendable in individual cases.
nationality_restrictions: Open worldwide - very long country list including Tunisia

Last degree <=6 years old; not resident in Germany >15 months. Funds only ARTISTIC projects - musicology/music education/scientific projects are excluded.
application_window: Applications via the DAAD portal; portal opens 1 June and closes on the deadline below
deadline: 24 September 2026 (Bewerbungsschluss 24.09.2026); selection meeting February 2027; funding starts from October 2027
deadline_source_cycle: 2027 cycle - this IS the window for a September/October 2027 start

red_flags: HARD BLOCKER FOR THIS CLIENT: requires a FIRST DEGREE IN MUSIC (or proof that no music degree exists in the home country and all local training has been exhausted). A software-engineering diploma plus a portfolio does not satisfy this. Audition/work-sample gated. Deadline 24 Sept 2026 is roughly one month away.
notes: German is NOT a funding condition per se - DAAD asks only for 'sufficient knowledge of the language of instruction' by the start of the scholarship; a German course is funded if needed and is compulsory only where the course is taught in German. Berlin's state music schools (UdK Berlin, HfM Hanns Eisler) teach mostly in German, which would make German a de-facto condition there.

applies_to_programs: Master/postgraduate degree in Fine Art, Design, Visual Communication or Film|Complementary course without a degree
amount_notes: 992 EUR/month, travel allowance on application, one-off study allowance, health/accident/personal-liability insurance contributions, possible rent subsidy and family allowance, Green Mobility top-up, funded language courses.
duration_covered: 10 to 24 months for a degree course; 12 months for complementary studies
nationality_restrictions: Open worldwide - long country list including Tunisia
tunisia_eligible_evidence: Country selector includes "...Trinidad and Tobago Tunisia Turkey Turkmenistan..." for this programme.

Worth a written eligibility query to DAAD Tunis if the client can argue an arts-field first degree. German is not a stated funding condition; only 'sufficient knowledge of the language of instruction'.

applies_to_institution: any state or state-recognised German university (Berlin: Universitaet der Kuenste Berlin, Hochschule fuer Schauspielkunst Ernst Busch)

scholarship_name: DAAD Helmut-Schmidt-Programme - Master's Scholarships for Public Policy and Good Governance

nationality_restrictions: Graduates from developing and emerging countries on the OECD-DAC list
tunisia_eligible_evidence: Country selector for this programme lists "...Timor-Leste Togo Tonga Tunisia Turkey Turkmenistan Tuvalu Uganda..."; call text: "Graduates from developing and emerging countries (bachelor or equivalent)".

application_window: 1 June to 31 July 2026 for the September/October 2027 intake - THIS WINDOW HAS ALREADY CLOSED
deadline_source_cycle: 2027 cycle (official call ST42 Helmut-Schmidt-Programm - Stipendienausschreibung 05/2026) - CLOSED; 2028 cycle expected to open 1 June 2027

scholarship_name: COST BASELINE - Semesterbeitrag and tuition at Berlin public universities (not a scholarship)
provider: Land Berlin state universities (TU Berlin, FU Berlin, HTW Berlin, HWR Berlin, BHT Berlin)
applies_to_institution: Technische Universitaet Berlin|Freie Universitaet Berlin|Hochschule fuer Technik und Wirtschaft Berlin (HTW)|Hochschule fuer Wirtschaft und Recht Berlin (HWR)|Berliner Hochschule fuer Technik (BHT)
amount_notes: Semester fee WINTER SEMESTER 2026/27, per semester, official figures: TU Berlin 379.06 EUR (admin 50.00 + student body 14.56 + studierendenWERK 85.00 + Semesterticket 226.80 + ticket social fund 2.70; 149.56 without the ticket). HWR Berlin 379.77 EUR (50.00 + 85.00 + AStA 17.97 + 226.80; 152.97 without ticket). FU Berlin 376.80 EUR (studierendenWERK 85.00 + admin 50.00 + AStA 10.00 + Deutschlandsemesterticket 226.80 + social fund 5.00). BHT Berlin 376.30 EUR (50.00 + 85.00 + student body 11.50 + ticket 226.80 + social fund 3.00). HTW Berlin 375.30 EUR (exchange students 325.30 EUR). Late re-registration surcharge 19.94 EUR everywhere.
duration_covered: Per semester, payable at enrolment and at every re-registration
nationality_restrictions: None - the same fee applies to EU and non-EU students
tunisia_eligible_evidence: HWR Berlin: "Studierende im Land Berlin zahlen derzeit fuer Bachelor- und konsekutive Masterstudiengaenge keine Studiengebuehren an den staatlichen Hochschulen." FU Berlin: "Die Freie Universitaet Berlin erhebt - ausser fuer weiterbildende Studienangebote - keine Studiengebuehren."
other_eligibility: The Semesterticket component (226.80 EUR) buys the Deutschlandsemesterticket - unlimited local and regional public transport across Germany for the whole semester. It is compulsory for on-campus students; exemption/subsidy schemes exist via the AStA social fund.
application_window: Payable by the enrolment / re-registration deadline each semester
deadline: Re-registration deadline each semester (TU Berlin: last Friday of lecture period at FU Berlin)
deadline_source_cycle: Winter semester 2026/27 figures - 2027/28 figures TBC but historically move by only a few euros
apply_via: Bank transfer to the university cashier
red_flags: NO TUITION applies only to Bachelor and CONSECUTIVE master's programmes at STATE universities. Weiterbildende (continuing-education / non-consecutive / executive) master's DO charge real fees even at state universities - HTW's Division of Continuing Education pays a different fee, and FU explicitly excludes weiterbildende Studienangebote from the no-tuition rule. Private Berlin institutions charge full tuition.
notes: This row exists so the Wave 4 ranking has the true Berlin cost in one place. Non-EU status changes NOTHING about the fee. Effective annual cost of studying at a Berlin public university = roughly 750-760 EUR of semester fees plus living costs; the semester fee already includes a Germany-wide transport ticket worth far more than its price. HU Berlin and UdK Berlin figures could not be retrieved (HU is behind an anti-bot wall, UdK has no published fee page found) - TBC, but the 50 EUR admin + 85 EUR studierendenWERK + 226.80 EUR ticket components are set by Land Berlin regulation and are identical everywhere.

scholarship_name: VISA COST BASELINE - German student visa proof of funds (Sperrkonto) for Tunisian applicants
scholarship_name_original: Finanzierungsnachweis / Sperrkonto - Check-list Etudes, Ambassade d'Allemagne Tunis
provider: Auswaertiges Amt / German Embassy Tunis (Ambassade d'Allemagne a Tunis)
amount_notes: German Embassy Tunis study-visa checklist: the amount required to finance one year of study is 11,904 EUR (992 EUR per month). Accepted proof: (a) a blocked account IN GERMANY, or (b) a Verpflichtungserklaerung under ss.66-68 AufenthG by a person resident in Germany. Since February 2023 the Embassy accepts ONLY a blocked account held at a GERMAN bank - a Tunisian blocked account is no longer accepted. National visa (D) fee 75.00 EUR, payable in TND in cash.
duration_covered: One year (renewed for each subsequent year via the Auslaenderbehoerde)
nationality_restrictions: Applies to Tunisian nationals applying at the Embassy in Tunis
tunisia_eligible_evidence: "Le montant prevu pour le financement d'une annee d'etudes s'eleve a 11.904 EUR (992 EUR par mois) (a) compte bloque en Allemagne" - Check-list Etudes, Ambassade d'Allemagne Tunis.
other_eligibility: The Etudes checklist also demands an UNCONDITIONAL admission letter (Certificat d'admission inconditionnel) plus proof of language: DSH or TestDaF for German-taught programmes, IELTS/TOEFL or equivalent for English-taught ones; a legalised baccalaureat and legalised university diploma with transcripts; and proof of health insurance.
application_window: Waiting-list registration with the Embassy, then an appointment via TLScontact; studies/study-preparation visas can now also be filed through the Consular Services Portal
deadline: No fixed deadline - but processing can take up to three months and appointment waiting times are published per category
deadline_source_cycle: Current as displayed 2026-08-22 (Etudes checklist page dated 25.07.2024; visa overview page updated 29.06.2026)
apply_via: German Embassy Tunis / TLScontact / Consular Services Portal (VIDEX form)
red_flags: 11,904 EUR must be liquid and parked in a GERMAN blocked account before the visa interview - this is the single largest cash barrier in the Berlin plan, and it is roughly 16x the annual semester fee. It changes yearly with the BAfoeG maximum rate; re-check in spring 2027.
notes: A SCHOLARSHIP REMOVES THIS REQUIREMENT. The Embassy runs a separate checklist, 'Boursiers d'Etat allemand/Erasmus+' (Boursiers d'Etat allemand / Erasmus+), whose document list contains NO financing proof at all - only the scholarship award letter (attestation de bourse), the German university's confirmation, passport, photos and health insurance for the whole stay. Scholarship holders also skip the waiting list (they book directly with TLScontact) and the 75 EUR visa fee is waived for holders of publicly funded scholarships. That makes 'win a public scholarship' worth about 12,000 EUR of liquidity on top of the stipend itself.

scholarship_name_original: Internationales Stipendienprogramm (ISP) des Avicenna-Studienwerks und des Islamkolleg Deutschland
provider: Avicenna-Studienwerk e.V. with Islamkolleg Deutschland, funded by the Auswaertiges Amt
applies_to_institution: any state or state-recognised German university (all Berlin public universities and state-recognised private ones qualify)
amount_notes: Master's level: 844 EUR/month stipend + 100 EUR/month health-insurance subsidy + 100 EUR/month mobility allowance = 1,044 EUR/month. Possible extras: 276 EUR family supplement, one-off start/book allowance of 100 EUR / 50 EUR. Doctoral level 1,275 EUR + the same two 100 EUR allowances.
duration_covered: The full standard period of the master's programme (Regelstudienzeit); extension possible
nationality_restrictions: International (non-Bildungsinlaender) Muslim students; no country list published
tunisia_eligible_evidence: "Das Stipendienprogramm richtet sich an internationale Studierende und Promovierende, die an einer Hochschule in Deutschland ein Masterstudium oder eine Promotion absolvieren wollen. Bildungsinlaender:innen koennen im Rahmen des ISP leider nicht gefoerdert werden."
other_eligibility: Above-average academic potential; social, cultural or political engagement; master's or doctorate at a state-recognised German institution; open regardless of age, gender or discipline. NOT fundable: Bildungsinlaender, bachelor's, part-time study, Staatsexamen, a second master's, and double funding by another Begabtenfoerderungswerk. Documents: motivation letter (max 2pp), CV (max 2pp), school-leaving certificate, university and work certificates, enrolment certificate if available, proof of social engagement, two academic references, passport copy, transcript of records.
application_window: 1 March to 15 April 2026 for funding starting 1 October 2026 - so expect roughly 1 March to 15 April 2027 for a 1 October 2027 start
deadline_source_cycle: 2026 cycle - 2027 TBC (window pattern 01.03.-15.04. for a 1 October funding start)
red_flags: The programme is explicitly for MUSLIM students - a confessional criterion the client must be comfortable declaring. No published country list, so Tunisia is 'likely' rather than confirmed; a one-line email to Enes Erdogan at Avicenna would settle it. Enrolment certificate must be supplied as soon as it exists.
notes: STRONGEST NON-DAAD PRE-ARRIVAL ROUTE FOUND FOR THIS CLIENT. No German-language condition is stated anywhere in the ISP call - documents may be submitted in German OR English, unlike the regular Avicenna Studienfoerderung which demands C1/DSH-2 from non-EU applicants. All subjects are eligible, so a computer-science or media/sound master's in Berlin fits. 1,044 EUR/month exceeds the DAAD rate. The application window (March-April 2027) sits AFTER most Berlin master's application deadlines, which is convenient: admission first, scholarship second.

provider: Avicenna-Studienwerk e.V. (BMBF-funded Begabtenfoerderungswerk for Muslim students)
applies_to_institution: any state or state-recognised German university
amount_notes: Up to 855 EUR/month means-tested Grundstipendium (BAfoeG-linked) + 300 EUR/month Studienkostenpauschale + 102 EUR health insurance + 35 EUR care insurance + 160 EUR per child, from winter semester 2024/25.
duration_covered: Up to the BAfoeG maximum funding period
nationality_restrictions: EU citizenship OR Bildungsinlaender status under s.8 BAfoeG
tunisia_eligible_evidence: "Staatsangehoerigkeit eines EU-Mitgliedslandes oder der Status eines Bildungsinlaenders/einer Bildungsinlaenderin im Sinne des s.8 BAfoeG"; FAQ: "Wenn Sie Ihr Abitur im Ausland absolviert haben und nicht die EU-Staatsbuergerschaft besitzen ... ist eine Bewerbung fuer die Studierendenfoerderung leider nicht moeglich."

red_flags: CLOSED to a Tunisian who took the baccalaureate in Tunisia. Also the '4 remaining semesters' rule would exclude any 2-semester or 3-semester master's even for an eligible applicant. Non-EU applicants who somehow qualify must additionally prove C1/DSH-2 German.
notes: Logged so the client does not confuse this with the ISP (FBE-010), which is the programme actually open to him. German C1/DSH-2 would be a hard funding condition here.

scholarship_name: Heinrich-Boell-Stiftung Studienwerk - scholarship for international students (Bildungsauslaender)
scholarship_name_original: Studienwerk der Heinrich-Boell-Stiftung - Studienstipendium fuer internationale Studierende
provider: Heinrich-Boell-Stiftung e.V. (Green-affiliated political foundation, HQ Schumannstr. 8, 10117 Berlin)
applies_to_institution: any state or state-recognised German university
amount_notes: Amount for international students not published on the pages read; the Boell Studienwerk follows the standard Begabtenfoerderung rates. TBC - do not assume the 992 EUR federal rate without confirming on the Boell financial-support page or Information Sheet A1-1b.
duration_covered: Standard period of study of the master's programme
nationality_restrictions: Open to Bildungsauslaender (applicants who obtained their higher-education entrance qualification abroad); explicit PRIORITY for applicants from OECD-DAC countries still in their home country at the time of application - Tunisia is a DAC country
tunisia_eligible_evidence: "Bewerben koennen sich internationale Studierende vor Beginn des Masterstudiums in Deutschland ... Vorrang haben Bewerber*innen aus DAC-Laendern, die sich zum Zeitpunkt der Bewerbung noch im Ausland befinden."
other_eligibility: Must apply BEFORE the master's starts. Only master's programmes with a standard study time of at least FOUR semesters are funded. An admission/enrolment confirmation should ideally accompany the application and must be produced at the latest immediately before the third-stage selection interview. Two expert references plus a reference on social commitment (English forms exist).
application_window: Two rounds a year. Published 2026 rounds: portal open 15 January to 1 March 2026, and 15 July to 1 September 2026. For an October 2027 start the natural round is the one closing 1 March 2027.
deadline: 1 March and 1 September annually; 1 September 2026 round is open right now
deadline_source_cycle: 2026 cycle published - the round for an October 2027 start (expected 15 Jan to 1 Mar 2027) is TBC
red_flags: THE FOUR-SEMESTER RULE IS A REAL FILTER: many Berlin master's programmes (and almost all one-year music/sound programmes) are shorter than 4 semesters and would be ineligible. The monthly amount for internationals is not published on the pages read - TBC. Political-foundation fit (Green values) is assessed.
notes: Tunisia's DAC status is an ADVANTAGE here, not a barrier - Boell gives priority to DAC-country applicants who are still at home when they apply, which is exactly the client's situation in early 2027. Application forms and the expert-report form exist in English (A1-1b, A1-3b, A1-4b), which strongly suggests German is not a hard funding condition - but this is not stated explicitly, so treat the German requirement as TBC.

scholarship_name: Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung Grundfoerderung fuer Auslaender:innen (basic scholarship for foreign students)
applies_to_institution: any state or state-recognised German university
applies_to_programs: all fields including artistic degree courses; bachelor, master, Diplom, Staatsexamen

deadline: TBC - FES publishes deadlines inside each scholarship programme description

Applications have to be submitted in German." This is a hard no for a client who prefers to avoid German.

scholarship_name_original: Studienwerk der Rosa-Luxemburg-Stiftung - Stipendienprogramm fuer internationale Studierende

amount_notes: "Das monatliche Grundstipendium betraegt derzeit 992 EUR. Hinzu kommen ggf. Zuschlaege." International doctoral candidates get 1,500 EUR + a 100 EUR mobility allowance + a 20 EUR flat-rate extra. Double funding (BAfoeG, Deutschlandstipendium, other public scholarships) is excluded.

nationality_restrictions: Exclusively for foreign nationals who are NOT in the group covered by s.8 BAfoeG and who are in Germany solely to study; EU nationals may also apply
tunisia_eligible_evidence: "Fuer das Studienstipendium fuer internationale Studierende koennen sich ausschliesslich Auslaender*innen bewerben ... Vorrang haben Bewerber*innen aus DAC-Laendern, die sich zum Zeitpunkt der Bewerbung noch im Herkunftsland aufhalten."
other_eligibility: Enrolment - or at least an ADMISSION LETTER - at a state or state-recognised German university; a completed bachelor's; very good academic results; social or political engagement in the spirit of the Rosa-Luxemburg-Stiftung; not more than 15 months in Germany at the time of application. Not fundable: a bachelor's, a second full master's, part-time study, the final stage of a degree, a change of subject in the master's.
application_window: One round a year: portal opens 20 August 2026, closes 1 October 2026, 23:59
deadline_source_cycle: 2026 cycle published - the round for an October 2027 start is expected to open around 20 August 2027 and close 1 October 2027; 2027 dates TBC
red_flags: GERMAN AT B2 IS A HARD, PROVEN FUNDING CONDITION - "sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (B2-Niveau) - Nachweis erforderlich" - even for an English-taught master's. The 1 October deadline also falls AFTER the October start of the funding year, so the client would be applying in autumn 2027 for funding that begins later, or in autumn 2026 for a 2027 start; clarify the funding-start rule with the Studienwerk before relying on it.
notes: Tunisia's DAC status is again an advantage: priority goes to DAC-country applicants still in their home country. Admission letter needed at application, so the Berlin admission must land before 1 October. The foundation is headquartered in Berlin, which makes the ideelle Foerderung programme easy to attend.

scholarship_name_original: Friedrich-Naumann-Stiftung fuer die Freiheit - Begabtenfoerderung, Auslaendische Bewerber Nicht EU
provider: Friedrich-Naumann-Stiftung fuer die Freiheit (FDP-affiliated political foundation)
applies_to_institution: any state or state-recognised German university (universities, Fachhochschulen, Kunsthochschulen)
amount_notes: "Das Stipendium betraegt 992 EUR monatlich." Plus 276 EUR spouse supplement and 259 EUR per accompanying child, and the health- and care-insurance contributions are paid for the scholarship holder and accompanying family. Side income up to 603 EUR gross/month (7,236 EUR per 12-month funding period) is allowed.
duration_covered: Minimum funding period two semesters; up to the standard period of study
nationality_restrictions: Non-EU foreign nationals may apply only for a FULL-TIME MASTER'S or a doctorate in Germany; non-EU applicants cannot be funded for a bachelor's
tunisia_eligible_evidence: "Auslaendische Bewerberinnen und Bewerber koennen sich um eine Foerderung bewerben, wenn sie einen Master beziehungsweise eine Promotion in Vollzeit in Deutschland absolvieren."
other_eligibility: Not more than 15 months spent in Germany before the start of funding (other than for research/study purposes), evidenced by residence stamps in the passport. Two university-teacher references. No FDP membership required. Tuition at PRIVATE German universities is NOT reimbursed. Second degrees, LL.M, MBA and part-time study are excluded.
application_window: Online portal only, 1 to 30 April and 1 to 31 October each year
deadline: 30 April and 31 October, 23:59 - for an October 2027 start the 31 October 2026 or 30 April 2027 round applies
deadline_source_cycle: Standing annual pattern published 2026; interview invitations by 8 February / 8 August
red_flags: GERMAN IS A HARD FUNDING CONDITION AND IS UNUSUALLY STRICT: "auch die Bewerbungsunterlagen sind auf Deutsch einzureichen. Ebenso findet das Auswahlgespraech in deutscher Sprache statt; auch dann, wenn Du Dich fuer die Foerderung eines englischsprachigen Studiengangs bewirbst." No language test is demanded, but the whole application and the selection interview are in German.
notes: Structurally one of the more open political-foundation routes for a non-EU master's applicant (no country list, no requirement to be in Germany already), and the twice-yearly window fits a 2027 start. The German-only application and interview is the blocker for this client, not nationality.

deadline_source_cycle: TBC - no dates published on the pages read on 2026-08-22

notes: Christian-social values orientation. Lower priority for this client than Avicenna ISP or Boell because of the B2 German gate and the unresolved detail.
